en.title: Splitting Cards Evenly into Packs
en.description: There are several types of cards, and cardTypes[i] is the number of cards of type i. You may add cards of existing types and choose a number of packs greater than 1 so that every pack contains the same number of cards of each type. Find the minimum number of cards to add.
en.input: The first line contains n, and the second line contains n positive integers cardTypes. Ranges: 1≤n≤10⁵ (original constraint), 1≤cardTypes[i]≤1000 (the original gives no upper bound on values; this is this site's OJ limit).
en.output: Output the minimum total number of cards to add.
en.explanation: For each possible number of packs, compute how many cards each type is short of the next multiple; enumerating pack counts up to the largest existing count plus 1 is enough to cover the optimal solution.
hints: With a fixed pack count k, each card type needs (k−count%k)%k more cards. Note that when cardTypes=[1], the optimal pack count is 2.
